summary: The joint resolution’s sole operative purpose is to terminate, under section 202 of the National Emergencies Act, 50 U.S.C. § 1622, the national emergency declared by the President on July 30, 2025, in Executive Order 14323, published at 90 Fed. Reg. 37739, which is identified in the resolution as the emergency declared to impose duties on articles imported from Brazil. The measure contains a single resolving clause and does not amend any provision of the United States Code, create any new authority, authorize or appropriate funds, prescribe implementing procedures, or establish exceptions, conditions precedent, deadlines, or a delayed effective date. Its operative mechanism is congressional termination of the specified national emergency pursuant to the National Emergencies Act.
